scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT workflows in verifier sandbox is infeasible; comparing agent's final numeric results to paper-reported tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band gap, short-circuit current, mobility ranges, peak power factors and optimal concentrations for TiMoCO2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper 812597389423542273: band gap 0.60 eV; short-circuit current 4.2 mA/cm²; hole mobility 133.61–142.39 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, electron mobility 19.65–29.99 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹; n-type peak power factor 33.7–49.8 μW cm⁻¹ K⁻² with optimal concentration ~4.0×10²⁰ cm⁻³; p-type peak power factor ~15–16 μW cm⁻¹ K⁻² with optimal concentration ~2.5×10¹⁹ cm⁻³.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's results section (numeric values are explicitly reported).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every gold value is identical to the paper's publicly reported number; the reference solution reproduces these same values within the declared tolerances, confirming correctness.

outputs.description: Thermoelectric power factor vs carrier concentration

output_contract.notes: All outputs generated by the agent must be placed in /app/outputs. The verifier reads them directly from that directory.
